story: My brother has illegally occupied our ancestral land in Bihar. How do I get it back?

facts.user_goal: To get back the illegally occupied ancestral land in Bihar
missing: Exact location/village of the land in Bihar
Details of the illegal occupation (e.g., date of taking over)
Relationship status with the brother (e.g., is he the only heir?)
Whether there are any existing legal documents or titles in the user's name

scope_message: This problem is outside what I have verified law for (I cover unpaid salary, consumer refunds and, partly, rental deposits). Rather than guess, please contact free legal aid: NALSA 15100 or Tele-Law 14454. They can advise you at no cost.
